mandateProjection.purpose: Observation Dataset and Outcome Dataset are separate. Vintages never mix. The Outcome Dataset asOf is a deterministic function of the bytes, never a build-time choice. A restatement produces a new DatasetId and leaves the prior Outcome unchanged.

vintageRules.outcomeDataset: historical snapshot of the window (T, T+H]
vintageRules.noVintageMixing: a DatasetId binds exactly one vintage
vintageRules.restatement: new DatasetId; the prior Outcome is unchanged
vintageRules.enforcementPoint: a vintage violation is refused at dataset construction, not at window resolution; the DatasetId cannot be bound, so no OutcomeWindowCause is required for it

outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.sessionSet: the sessions of (T, T+H] enumerated by the pinned calendar registry (calendarRegistryManifestId, C1), a closed and finite set
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.settlingInstant: availableAt of the INITIAL_ROOT revision of the bar of that session
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.asOf: max over the sessionSet of settlingInstant, equivalently the first instant at which every bar of (T, T+H] has availableAt <= asOf
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.outcomeDataset: the GATE21 snapshot defined at that asOf
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.asOfIsDerivedNeverStored: DatasetSnapshotCore/1 and DatasetSnapshotRecord/1 carry no as-of field and need none; the instant is derived and the snapshot stays content-addressed
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.emissionInstant: at the asOf, not at horizon expiry; DatasetId_outcome is a mandatory member of a closed tuple so no OutcomeId can be struck before the asOf
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.attestationQualityNote: determinism of the instant is bounded by knowledgeMode; under CAPTURE_TIME_ONLY the availableAt is a capture rather than an attested publication; declared availability fact, not a reservation on the rule
